subject: [PATCH 07/60] mm/memory-tiers: restrict demotion topology to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original author posted a duplicate message to themselves via B4 Relay, which doesn't add any new content or discussion.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts the demotion topology to common memory by changing various functions in mm/memory-tiers.c to use N_MEMORY_COMMON instead of N_MEMORY. This is done to prevent nodes outside the ordinary allocation pool from being used as generic demotion sources or destinations.
